purpose: Reads text or binary content from a local file path safely.
capability: Reads full or partial contents of a file given its path and optional encoding or mode.

output.content: string or bytes (content of the file)

interface: index.py -> read_file_content(path: str, encoding: str = 'utf-8', binary: bool = False) -> dict
boundary: File system access limited to provided path. Does not handle remote URLs or non-file resources.
composition: Can be composed with parse-json-structured, extract-regex-pattern, or diff-text-delta.
failure_behavior: Raises FileNotFoundError if file does not exist, PermissionError if unreadable, or UnicodeDecodeError if encoding fails.
operational_readiness: Production ready. Pure Python standard library implementation.
